locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 1

segments.text: Active listening is a foundation communication skill. Its primary assumption is that the listener is trying to understand the speaker's point of view or experience. The following tips, though not always possible in a given moment or place, will aid our effort to hear and understand what the speaker is saying.

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 2
Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 3

segments.text: Choose to listen (or not): If you cannot listen now but are willing, set a time for later.

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 4

segments.text: Find a good space: Choose a place to talk without distractions.

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 5

segments.text: Take the time: Let the other person tell their story.

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 6

segments.text: Respond (vs. react): Choose your body language, tone, and intention.

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 7

segments.text: Show interest: Make eye contact; focus on the person speaking; don't answer your phone or look at your email.

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 8

segments.text: "Hear" as well as listen: It is normal to miss some words or not know their meaning. Ask: "Could you say that again?" "Could you explain.?"

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 9

segments.text: Ask questions: Ask for more information, for what happened. Ask if you understand: "Are you saying that ... ?"

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 10

segments.text: Clarify/Paraphrase: Not everyone knows exactly what they mean to say. Check your understanding. For example, "It sounds like what you are saying is____. Is that right?"

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 11

segments.text: Be patient: It's not easy for people to talk about important things.

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 12

segments.text: Listen for content and emotion: both carry the meaning at hand. It's OK sometimes to say, "How are you doing with all this?"

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 13

segments.text: Learn: Listen for their perspective/their view. Listen for their experience. Discover or learn a new way of seeing something.

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 14

segments.text: Follow their lead: See where they want to go. Ask what is important to them (rather than deciding where their story must go or how it must end).

locator.section: Key Tips for Active Listening, article block 15

segments.text: Be kind: Listen with heart as well as with mind.
